logline: A noir detective in 1920s Shanghai hunts a ghost from his past.
note: Real before/after from the deployed backend. The regenerate endpoint (POST /shots/{id}/regenerate with use_drift_correction=true) fetches the prior drift report and injects the per-attribute scores into the Veo prompt as targeted corrective context (e.g. "prior face identity 0.70 — preserve the exact facial features from the reference"), then re-runs generation and re-checks. The before/after are from two independent Veo 3.1 generations of the same shot; the regeneration received the drift-diagnosis context, the first generation did not. The improvement (face 0.70->0.80, age 0.70->0.90, beard 0.70->0.90) is consistent with the corrective context directing Veo to prioritize the drifted dimensions.
